exposure: maternal progesterone use (suppositories or injections) during pregnancy
cohort: A cohort of 97 children diagnosed with ADHD and 194 age- and sex-matched controls were included.
finding: Overall maternal progesterone use during pregnancy was not significantly associated with the development of ADHD in offspring, although continuous progesterone use throughout all trimesters was more frequent among ADHD cases.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common in the ADHD group.
